_note: Everything that happens every single week, whichever rotation week it is. Recipe ids are keys in recipes.json.

rhythm.what: Order online. Open the basket, add to the trolley, book the slot.
Pizza dough out of the freezer into the fridge.
Delivery. Pizza night - every week, no exceptions.
Sandwiches for lunch. Prep session in the evening, 2-3 hours. That night's dinner is the traybake, cooked during the session.
Tuna pasta salad for lunch, made {{d+1}}. Roast for dinner.
Leftovers from the roast, build-your-own. Together night.
Shift dinners - reheats, slow cooker, oven timers. Nothing over 15 minutes' active effort.
{{d+6}}'s freezer bag out of the freezer into the fridge.

adults.notes: 1 dough ball, passata, that week's topping, less mozzarella than the boys'. Topping under the cheese.

friday_pizza.salad: Every Friday has a salad alongside - see the week's page.

saturday_lunch.notes: Cold lunch - bread, ham, cheddar, salad, pickled onions. Double filling on the adults'.

sunday_lunch.notes: Made Saturday. Yoghurt and seeds added on Sunday.

breakfast_bags.notes: Fill all bags one ingredient at a time, standing open in a tub. Seal, squish to mix, freeze flat. One bag from freezer to fridge each night. Morning: tip into bowl, add 100ml water or milk, stir. Berries on top. Banana on the side on training days. 5g creatine in a glass of water separately.

boiled_eggs.usage: 2 in the tuna pasta salad, 4 in Friday's salad, 4 in Friday's lunch boxes, 2 spare

pickled_onions.frequency: Every Saturday, or skip if the jar from last week is still good - they keep 4-6 weeks.

flapjacks.frequency: Every Saturday, first thing in the oven at 180C
flapjacks.notes: The variant changes per week - see the week's page.

lunch_boxes.finishers: Different every day - see the week's page.
lunch_boxes.build_notes: Bottom-to-top so the leaves stay out of the dressing. Finisher last, and on the day - crunchy things and boiled eggs never go in on Saturday.

mon.notes: That week's roast protein, in on Saturday

tue.notes: That week's roast protein, in on Saturday

wed.notes: Flaked in on the day, skin off. A 140g pack is 70g a box. The oily-fish day.

thu.notes: Cooked peeled prawns, in on the day.

fri.notes: 80g tuna plus 2 boiled eggs, in on the day.

per_day.yoghurt: Small pot of full-fat Greek yoghurt with a few frozen berries

packed_lunch.notes: Made the night before, fridge overnight. Frozen berries thaw by lunch. Ham filling for now - branch out later.

dressings.notes: Make the three oil-based dressings in jars on day 1 of the cycle. They keep 3-4 weeks. Mint yoghurt is weekly and only needed in week 2.

cycle_1.description: Double the freezer bags - 2 per week instead of 1. Batch pots bank 1 bag each on top. Goal is ~9 dinners banked by the end of the month.

cycle_2_onwards.description: Single freezer bags only. Batch pots still bank 1 bag each. The freezer grows slowly.

freezer_bank.freezer_week: When the tub holds 8+ bags, skip a cook session. Shop only fresh things. Eat 5 bags that week, oldest first.

cook_order.detail: First in the oven, 180C. They cool while everything else cooks.
Oven up to 200C once the flapjacks are out. The lunch box veg goes in.
Marinated or oiled, on a second tray alongside the veg.
Tonight's dinner. In alongside or straight after the veg.
On the hob, simmering through all of the oven work.
While the pot simmers. 8 minutes, then cold water.
Freezer bags assembled, breakfast bags filled, dressings made, pickles done, tuna pasta salad made.
Last, once the veg and protein have cooled enough. Monday and Tuesday's four get the roast protein now; the other six get the base only and a label saying add protein on the day.
Tubs to the fridge, bags to the freezer, everything labelled with the month.
Anything tomorrow's roast wants doing the night before.

not_made_saturday.what: All pasta, rice, orzo and couscous - cooked fresh on the day, every time.
Fried eggs and anything crunchy for the lunch boxes.
{{day}}'s peppers and anything else that wants to be hot.
The tarka, if it is a dal week.
Wednesday's lunch box mackerel - flaked in on the day, skin off.
Thursday's lunch box prawns - straight from the pack on the day.
Friday's lunch box tuna and boiled eggs - in on the day.
Eldest's packed lunch - made each evening.

defaults.notes: Defaults for the settings panel, and what the build falls back to. delivery_day is slot 0 of day_order in rotation.json - every other slot is counted from it, so prep is delivery+1 and the roast is delivery+2 whatever weekday delivery lands on. Lunch boxes are the exception: they are absolute working weekdays, Monday to Friday, and do not move with delivery. delivery_days_allowed is Thu-Sat because the prep session that cooks Monday and Tuesday's box protein has to fall before the working week. anchor_date is the first delivery day of cycle 1. current_cycle 'auto' works it out from the anchor; '1' or '2' pin it. week_start_day is reading order only and moves nothing.
